description.description: Short human-readable description of what happened.

event_id.description: Stable identifier for this trigger event (UUID or similar).

evidence_hint.description: Optional pointer-like hint (URL or object reference) for supporting evidence.

observed_by.description: Entity asserting the trigger occurred (operator or watcher).

related_notice_id.description: Optional PublicNotice.notice_id expected to cover this trigger.

severity.description: Optional severity of the underlying situation.
